name: GraphicConverter
price: $39.95 / €34.95 one-time (upgrade $25.95, family $59.95); $34.99 on the Mac App Store; shareware trial
last_update: 2026-08-27 (12.5.4 on the Mac App Store; 12.6 beta build 7423 on 2026-11-12)
engine: Own import/export (~200 formats in, ~80 out); videos via AVKit
summary: GraphicConverter is a long-running Mac 'pocket knife for pictures': a file and picture browser, slideshow, editor and batch converter that opens about 200 formats. Its browser also plays QuickTime-compatible movies and audio, handles extensive metadata and has duplicate finding, flat views and Spotlight search.
where_it_wins: Opens ~200 image formats, exports ~80, including legacy and scientific formats
Full image editor and powerful batch conversion with actions
Deep metadata editing (EXIF/IPTC/XMP, faces, GPS map)
Rich slideshow options (transitions, random, metadata, sorting during the show)
List, Cover Flow and thumbnail views, flat view of all subfolders
Duplicate finder, contact sheets, web galleries
where_schnellbild_wins: Free and open source, no shareware limits
MKV, WebM, AVI, WMV, FLV via built-in VLC; subtitle/audio track choice and speed in its own control bar
ZIP/RAR/7z and CBZ/CBR as folders, including videos inside
Keyboard first, boss key, printable cheat sheet
Always sandboxed and never online (direct GC build is not sandboxed and checks for updates)
Slideshow through all subfolders with photos and videos mixed
Simple, fast UI without editor clutter

free.note: $39.95 / €34.95 direct (upgrade $25.95, family $59.95), $34.99 on Mac App Store; shareware trial with few limits, batch disabled unregistered

no_account_no_tracking.note: App Privacy: Data Not Collected; no account

dark_light_setting.note: Settings > General > Appearance: always light, always dark, or system

languages_20.note: 14 (English + 13 per App Store; vendor lists Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese x2, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish)

folder_browsing.note: File and picture browser on folders; MAS build needs folders added by drag and drop (sandbox)

thumbnail_grid.note: Thumbnails with folder tree; multi-frame previews for movies

list_view.note: Thumbnails, List, Cover Flow and Small List displays

recursive_search.note: Browser search field searches the folder and all subfolders via Spotlight (fails where Spotlight is off, e.g. many network shares); Browse Flat shows all subfolders

regex_search.note: RegEx in 'Slide Show with find' and Rename dialog, not in the browser search field

network_shares_fast.note: No speed claims for network volumes; the manual notes the browser search relies on Spotlight. Searched manual and site.

multiple_windows.note: Several browser windows ('Show in New Browser', drag between two browsers)

bookmarks.note: Favorites area under the file tree

img_raw.note: Camera RAW import (some RAF/X3F missing in MAS build)

img_animated.note: GIF and APNG animations play in the browser, optional loop

keyboard_paging.note: Next/previous image in browser, viewer and slideshow

slideshow.note: Full-screen or window, random, transitions, metadata overlay, rate/move/trash during show

slideshow_recursive.note: Slideshow can include subfolders; whether movies play inside the slideshow is not documented

auto_enhance_view.note: Auto Levels and an Auto Enhancement batch action exist, but they edit the picture (saved on save), not a view-only toggle.

file_info_exif.note: Extensive metadata (EXIF/IPTC/XMP, MOV/MP4 metadata); video codec/bitrate not documented

wrong_extension_note.note: Browser command Filename Extension › Verify and correct checks the selected files and corrects mismatched extensions; no passive note while viewing.

video_native.note: Browser plays movies in the right pane via AVKit

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: Only what AVKit/QuickTime plays; can convert AVI to MP4

photos_videos_one_grid.note: Movies show in the browser among pictures

video_skim_arrows.note: Movie controls in the browser's right pane are described only briefly; arrow-key skimming not stated.

subtitles_embedded.note: Manual has no subtitle feature; whether the standard movie controls offer a subtitle menu is not stated.

subtitles_external_files.note: No subtitle files anywhere in the complete manual.

audio_track_choice.note: Not in the manual; depends on the standard movie controls, not documented.

playback_speed.note: Manual mentions only the playback-speed tag in video metadata, not a player speed control.

control_bar_movable.note: AVKit controls; slideshow navigation palette is movable, but not for video

playlist.note: Slideshow list palette; not a video playlist

saved_playlists.note: Slideshow presets and saved searches, not playlists

music_mode.note: MP3 and M4A play in the browser's right pane

streaming_urls.note: Can load single images from a URL; no streams

online_subtitles.note: No subtitle features in the manual.

video_filters_enhance.note: Manual covers converting/scaling movies, not view adjustments during playback.

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: Quick Look appears only as a full-screen preview option; no Quick Look generator for video formats; for MP2 the manual recommends VLC.

archives_as_folders.note: Can open images from RAR archives; no browsing of ZIP/7z as folders documented

comics_cbz_cbr.note: CBZ/CBR not in the manual's format list or text.

archive_passwords.note: Manual mentions only opening images from RAR archives; no archive passwords.

split_archives.note: No multi-part archives in the manual.

videos_in_archives.note: Archive support is described for images from RAR only.

manga_two_page.note: No two-page or right-to-left reading mode in the manual.

rename_trash.note: Rename (presets, RegEx, QR code), delete, new folder

move_copy.note: Drag and drop between browsers and Finder

dual_pane.note: Several browser windows can be placed side by side and dragged between; no two-pane mode with F5/F6.

undo_file_actions.note: Undo in browser via system file revisions (can be turned off)

image_editing.note: Full editor: crop, resize, filters, effects, ~80 export formats

batch_convert.note: Batch conversion with actions, batch rename

library_catalog.note: Ratings, labels, tags, faces in file metadata; duplicate finder; no central database

cloud_sync.note: FTP upload, web gallery export, cloud folders via their clients (no direct cloud access in MAS build)

keyboard_first.note: Shortcuts are editable; whether all browser work is possible without the mouse is not documented.

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Shortcut tables in the PDF manual

boss_key.note: No hide-all key in the manual's shortcut tables.

app_sandbox.note: Mac App Store build is sandboxed (with restrictions); the direct build is not

no_network.note: Checks for updates online; maps, FTP, image from URL

notarized_attested.note: Closed source, so the build cannot be attested; the manual does not cover notarization.
